title: Concept: Git configuration file served in a response
description: A .git/config body with repository settings in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The config names remotes and can carry credentials in the remote URL, and its presence also confirms that the whole .git directory is downloadable, including history and stash.
applicability: Deployments that render a .git/config body with repository settings into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The config names remotes and can carry credentials in the remote URL, and its presence also confirms that the whole .git directory is downloadable, including history and stash.
